In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], the [[Scout ship/Legends|exploratory ship]] ''[[Pythea]]'' was exploring the edge of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] when it came across the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]], resulting in a '''skirmish'''. The captain of the ship, [[Panha]], recognized the invaders and attempted to warn [[Artorias]] of the impending danger. The Yuuzhan Vong closed on the ship and launched a boarding party to take the crew of the ''Pythea'' as prisoners. Panha and her co-pilot [[Sarkkin]] managed to fight them off but realized that they were doomed. They decided to sacrifice themselves and strike a blow against the invaders. They managed to destroy a [[Yorik-vec assault cruiser]] and damage a [[Miid ro'ik|Miid Ro'ik]] [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]].
